title: SECOND OPINION: R11 head-to-head IS implemented — first evaluator was wrong
evidence: soccer_mcp.py:145 head_to_head(team_a, team_b) returns team_a_wins/team_b_wins/draws (W/L/D); registered as MCP tool at soccer_mcp.py:187; exercised by passing test test_soccer_mcp.py:27 (defect_rate=1.0). Verified head_to_head tool registered: True.
suggestion: Classify R11 as implemented. The Atletico conflation is a data-value correctness defect (owned by the factual gate, factual_accuracy=0.5), not a missing capability; the '19 of 20 clubs' evidence is about standings (R9), not head-to-head.

title: Team-name normalization conflates Atletico-MG / Athletico-PR / Atletico-GO
evidence: soccer_mcp.py:31 _key() strips the -MG/-PR/-GO state suffix so 'Atletico-PR' -> 'atletico'; soccer_mcp.py:109 _team_match() then substring-matches so _team_match('Atletico Mineiro','Atletico-PR')==True (verified). head_to_head/search_matches/team_stats over-count for any Atletico query.
suggestion: Preserve the state suffix as a disambiguator (map -MG->Mineiro, -PR->Paranaense) and require exact key equality rather than substring containment. Captured by the factual gate (factual_accuracy=0.5).

title: Six source files concatenated without dedup — unfiltered aggregates double/triple-count fixtures
evidence: soccer_mcp.py:84-100 appends Brasileirao_Matches.csv + novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv + BR-Football-Dataset.csv (all Serie A) with no reconciliation; test asserts len(matches)==23954 (test_soccer_mcp.py:12) = the sum of all files. head_to_head/statistics without a competition filter inflate results; _factual.json hint notes the same fixture appears in 2-3 files.
suggestion: Deduplicate on (date, home, away) allowing +/-1 day for UTC vs local kickoff. A competition-filtered query (standings/statistics season=2019, competition=Brasileirao) is unaffected and correct (380 matches). Captured by the factual gate.

title: Standings for 2019 Serie A shows 19 of 20 clubs (one Atletico row instead of two)
evidence: _factual.json: '2019 Serie A: all 20 clubs present: expected 20 of 20, got 19 of 20 (1 Atletico/Athletico row(s), expected 2)'. standings() (soccer_mcp.py:159) keys on raw team name but the source labelling collapses the two Atleticos. Same name-normalization root cause as bug-atletico-conflation.
suggestion: Normalize/disambiguate the two Atletico clubs so both appear. Already owned by the factual gate; recorded here for the human report, not double-counted in the mechanical penalty.
